user.title: Aquarium Dosing
user.description: Create a Toggle helper first (Settings > Devices & services > Helpers > Create helper > Toggle) and select it as the master toggle. ON allows scheduled dosing, OFF pauses it, for example during a water change. Add the integration again for a second aquarium, each with its own toggle.

data.one_at_a_time: Run one pump at a time

data_description.one_at_a_time: Doses wait for each other. Turn off only if each pump has its own power supply.
data_description.late_tolerance_minutes: A scheduled dose more than this late (for example after a restart) is skipped, never caught up.

pump.title: First pump
pump.description: Pick the switch that powers the pump. More pumps, schedules and the operating window are set in the Aquarium Dosing card. New pumps start with the schedule disabled.

error.invalid_name: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only (max 32 characters).

abort.already_configured: That master toggle is already used by another aquarium.
